panel_source: v0.21 registry (24 brands across cells A=Prestige, B=Celebrity-DTC/Cult, C=Drugstore)

market_share_source.name: Cosmetics top-50 brands by 2024-2025 market presence
market_share_source.citation: Composite of publicly available cosmetics brand rankings: WWD Top 100 Beauty 2024 (cosmetics segment); Statista Cosmetics Brands by Revenue Worldwide 2024; Allure Best of Beauty 2024 expanded brand index. Snapshot frozen at v1.6-prereg-r1 lock date.
market_share_source.note: Off-panel brands. Panel-overlapping market-share brands appear in panel_brands instead.

cross_validated_emergents_source: Cosmetics-relevant brands surfaced in v0.20 (skincare) Phase B logs and corroborated against the market-share list above. Phase-B-only candidates excluded per locked rule.

validity_anchor.rationale: v0.21 §4.5 documented Glossier appearing in cultural-channel q6 for 6/6 panel LLMs (a single-query full-panel saturation event). v1.6 K=6 threshold anchored to this demonstration. Validity check: Glossier R_phantom ≥ 6 under v1.6 measurement.
validity_anchor.source_note: Glossier is a v0.20 Cell B panel brand (skincare substrate), NOT on the v0.21 cosmetics panel. Its persistence in v0.21 Phase B logs is the empirical motivation for the Phantom construct.

notes: Off-panel reference brands are scored for R_phantom = R_cat_phantom + R_cult_phantom across all 36 Phase B responses (max 36 per brand).
Detection uses v1.4 canonical mention rules (case-insensitive, accent-stripped, word-boundary anchored).
Vocabulary held constant across the 3 cells within the substrate; not cell-specific.

Panel-vs-off-panel distinction matters for the verdict matrix: H_PhantomBrandPersistence claims off-panel ≥1 brand at R_phantom ≥ K. Panel brands' R_phantom is computed but does not contribute to the off-panel count.
